$schema_note: Machine-readable manifest of Xnurta MCP official skills. Version fields must stay in sync with each skill's SKILL.md frontmatter (`metadata.version`).

skills.name: xnurta-query-ads-performance
skills.description: Query advertising performance metrics: spend, clicks, sales, ACOS, ROAS, trends, rankings, period comparison, plus hourly (AMS), keyword-placement, and Vendor ASIN (shipped/ordered, distributorView/sellingProgram) breakdowns.

skills.name: xnurta-query-entity-metadata
skills.description: Query advertising entity metadata: configuration and delivery status, campaign budget usage (remaining budget, budget status, in/out-of-budget time), category and brand targeting IDs, the SB/SD creation entities (brand, store, page ASINs, creative assets, SD audiences), managed-group schedules, campaign enabled-rule types, and managed-group Rule-mode configuration.

skills.name: xnurta-query-operation-log
skills.description: Query operation logs: user and AI action history on ad entities (bid, budget, status changes), including the entity- and profile-count-dependent timestamp timezone rules.

skills.name: xnurta-create-ai-group
skills.description: Create SP, SB, or SD AI managed groups and assign campaigns after explicit confirmation, optionally from a platform template recommended by campaign purpose, and with an SP/SB schedule.

skills.name: xnurta-edit-ai-group
skills.description: Edit one or multiple AI managed groups with confirmation and read-back verification; apply templates (recommended by campaign purpose) and manage SP/SB group schedules.

skills.name: xnurta-delete-ai-group
skills.description: Delete an AI managed group and explicitly release or migrate its campaigns.

skills.name: xnurta-edit-ads
skills.description: Edit live ad entities in bulk via batch_update_ads: campaign budget / state / bidding / portfolio membership, portfolio budgets and dates, ad group state, keywords, targets, promoted products and negatives, including expansion from keyword lists. 31 routes, 15 that may require two-phase confirmation.

skills.name: xnurta-create-campaign
skills.description: Create new SP, SB and SD campaigns in bulk, add ad groups to existing campaigns of any type, and create portfolios - with promoted products, targeting, negatives and SB/SD creatives. New-campaign creation also supports placement adjustments and an optional AMC audience. Which ad types are enabled is server configuration.

skills.name: xnurta-manage-keyword-list
skills.description: Manage keyword lists (corpus): search and inspect lists, create one with keywords and linked products, add or remove keywords or products, change visibility, and delete with two-phase confirmation. Lists are referenced by id from campaigns, ad groups and AI managed groups; the match type is chosen there, not on the list.

skills.name: xnurta-query-market-data
skills.description: Query Amazon market and peer data outside the account: SQP / ABA search-term demand, share and top-3 ASINs via get_market_search_perf, and Sponsored Ads brand peer benchmarks (P25 / P50 / P75 by brand, category, ad product and goal) via get_peer_benchmark. Weekly search data; benchmarks weekly or monthly. One store per call, never joined to ad data.

skills.name: xnurta-weekly-ads-report
skills.description: Generate a weekly ad performance recap: KPI card with WoW comparison, 7-day trend, anomalies, top movers, next-week actions.

skills.name: xnurta-monthly-ads-report
skills.description: Generate a monthly ad performance recap: full-month KPIs (MoM + YoY), structural breakdown, product and keyword analysis, next-month recommendations.

skills.name: xnurta-ads-structure-analysis
skills.description: Analyze spend and efficiency breakdown across campaign type / marketplace / portfolio / weekday / hour-of-day dimensions and flag structural mismatches.

skills.name: xnurta-product-diagnosis
skills.description: Diagnose ASIN-level health: portfolio tiering plus a separate lifecycle stage from SP advertising age and total-sales trend, variant comparison, diagnostic cards for underperformers, keep/optimize/cut recommendations.

skills.name: xnurta-asin-deep-dive
skills.description: Deep-dive one ASIN or parent ASIN: traffic and ad structure, variants, stock and ACOS mechanism. Use platform SQP / ABA and available competitorProduct data first; brand peer benchmarks are context only. SellerSprite can add organic rank and broader category or competitor comparisons.

skills.name: xnurta-search-term-diagnosis
skills.description: Diagnose search-term spend with fixed, reproducible rules: spend distribution by order tier, brand vs non-brand, negative candidates (incl. pausing zero-order exact keywords), harvest candidates and fragmented exact keywords; thresholds from the store's order value and target ACOS. Read-only.

skills.name: xnurta-sqp-insight
skills.description: Read-only SQP and weekly ABA diagnosis for selected terms or ASINs, with optional ad performance and change history as context. Uses MCP only; no execution plan.

skills.name: xnurta-category-scorecard
skills.description: Read-only performance and matched brand peer ranges for one specified category or confirmed ASIN scope. Uses MCP only; no whole-store scoring or budget allocation.

skills.name: xnurta-promo-prep
skills.description: Before a promotion, check readiness (stock vs event demand, portfolio caps and end dates, campaigns already out of budget, managed-group schedules), size the push to the user's event budget, and prepare it: role-matched dated schedules for eligible SP/SB managed groups (Promotion sales boost only for head groups the user confirms; others on Drive growth or kept on Optimize ROAS), budget / bid / top-of-search raises for campaigns outside groups, a product-line summary, preview, change log and read-back.

skills.name: xnurta-promo-monitor
skills.description: During a promotion, read today's hourly spend pace, current budget usage and today's changes, classify every campaign (winner running out, not converting, over the limit, ...), and propose small capped moves for the user's goal right now (push, slow down, push ASINs, stay inside a limit), including event-day pause and low-stock questions - with preview, change log and read-back.

skills.name: xnurta-promo-reset
skills.description: After a promotion, recover every human bid, budget, placement and managed-group change and its pre-promo value from the operation log, and restore it - all at once, or by post-promo performance (now, stepped down over days, or left to the customer), as the user chooses - or from the customer's own uploaded record of the pre-promo values - with preview, undo file and read-back.
